name: 46368 · Portage, IN
findings: ZIP 46368 (Portage) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46368 (Portage) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46368 (Portage) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
